copy.section_subtitle: Coordinate panel finishes and selectable modules for hotel guest room and OEM/ODM projects.
copy.intro_text: Review representative panel layouts for lighting, curtain control, room status, key-card power, thermostat control, sockets, USB, and low-voltage functions. Each layout is a project configuration example rather than a fixed stock SKU.
copy.disclaimer_text: Images show OEM/ODM configuration examples, not standard stock SKUs. Modules, colors, panel layouts, functions, and quantities can be adapted to project requirements. Final configuration, compatibility, MOQ, lead time, and quotation are subject to project review and written confirmation.
copy.card_note: Configuration example. Final module selection and production scope require project confirmation.

implementation_validation_plan: Confirm exactly nine copied public images and unique public paths.
Confirm all four series are represented.
Confirm the module appears only on /en/solutions/oem-odm-custom-panel-solution/.
Confirm no new route or sitemap URL is created.
Confirm no Product, Offer, Review, Rating or ImageObject schema is added.
Confirm all images use /media/oem-odm-configurations/ paths and no WordPress upload URLs.
Confirm responsive one-, two-, and three-column layouts without overflow.
Confirm all images lazy load and use stable aspect-ratio containers.
Confirm the disclaimer and project-confirmation wording are visible.
Run lint, data tests, static export build, and focused output scans in the implementation stage.
